# Camp Resource: Poisoned Earth Well

Even this fouled well can serve a purpose.

Generates Acid, Dirty Water, and Nuclear Waste.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Poisoned Earth Well__

**Produces**

Dirty Water

Acid

Nuclear Waste

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

(We both know the wood pile is going to be involved in this again XD)

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Water

**Materials required to craft resource**

1x Rubber

2x Steel

1x Concrete

**Holds**

1 Pound

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
